name: Navidrome
param_style: squirrel `?` rewritten to dbx named params {:p0},{:p1}... (persistence/sql_base_repository.go:358), normalised to ?N; a few raw SQL strings built with fmt.Sprintf/strings.Replace; user ids inlined as literals in two join builders
schema_source: reconstructed by replaying db/migrations (goose .sql + SQL strings in .go migrations) in order; only the CREATE statements the queries need are kept (GPL)
data_scale: scale 1: 3 libraries, 20 users, 1000 artists, 3000 albums, 30k tracks (+FTS5 via triggers), ~36k annotations, 62 playlists, 40k scrobbles
visibility_note: 24k stars; the most widely deployed self-hosted Subsonic-compatible music server; SQLite is its only database
interest_note: Album/song list pages with per-user annotation LEFT JOINs and library IN-subqueries; FTS5 two-phase search (bm25 rowid page numbered by row_number() and joined back); smart playlists compiled to INSERT ... SELECT with window numbering and json_tree tag predicates; scanner CTE upserts with json_tree/json_group_object.
reach_note: widely self-hosted music server; SQLite only
